name: Zacharenia Atzitzikaki
title: Business Coach at The 10x Manager Academy
bio: Zaharenia Atzitzikaki has over 18 years of experience working in tech, with more than half of them focusing on product design and enterprise software. She now works as a business coach, training her clients to become better leaders at The 10x Manager Academy. She writes about management in her biweekly newsletter, Leading by Design.

name: Aristeidis Bampakos
title: Angular Google Developer Expert (GDE)
bio: Aristeidis Bampakos works as a Web Development Team Leader at Plex-Earth, specializing in developing web applications using Angular. He is a Google Developer Expert (GDE) for Angular and is passionate about helping the developer community learn and grow. His love for teaching has led him to become an award-winning author of Learning Angular and Angular Projects books, as well as an Angular Senior Tech Instructor at Code.Hub, where he nurtures aspiring Angular developers and professionals.

name: Evi Chatzidaki
title: Software Engineer
bio: Experienced software engineer in the telco industry that enjoys developing systems with strict performance and latency requirements. Worked in different positions of product development throughout the years(software tester, devops engineer), but found true passion for software development. Participated in Java Hellenic User Groups (JHUG) meetups.

name: Vasilis Christopoulos
title: Co-founder at Programium
bio: Vasilis Christopoulos is a Software Engineer and Co-founder at Programium, a boutique technical consultancy that partners with businesses to build high quality scalable custom software. With a strong background in engineering and a focus on delivery excellence, Vasilis specializes in crafting exceptional digital experiences and robust architectures. Based in Athens, he is a passionate advocate for open-source technologies and hands-on technical leadership.

name: Giorgos Gkogkolis
title: Senior Software Architect at Etraveli Group
bio: George Gkogkolis, a graduate of the University of Peloponnese has been working with software since 2007, specializing in back-end (both with Java and C#), secure programming, and software architecture.

name: Giorgos Kalfopoulos
title: Chief of Engineering Evolution @ Superbo
bio: Started some 20+ years ago as a Java Software Developer, evolved to Architect (technical, solution, cloud, enterprise, and potentially a few more variations along the way, some of which are even certified,  and currently attempting to pass on the knowledge to the following generations as Head of Engineering. Perhaps above all though, a  community junkie (following JHUG, GreeceJS, Angular Athens, DDD Greece, and a few more) and a proud organizer of Ministry of Testing Athens, the largest QA community in Greece.

name: Elias Niaos
title: Seasoned Software Engineer @ Prodyna
bio: Elias Niaos is a seasoned Software Engineer with over 15 years of experience in the digital trenches, currently navigating the world of software at Prodyna. Focused on simplifying complexities and deconstructing challenges, he works to foster innovative solutions. Outside of coding, Elias finds fulfillment as a parent of two and contributes to the GreeceJS community with dedication and expertise

name: Christos Paisios
title: Staff Software Engineer & Engineering Leader
bio: Christos Paisios is a staff software engineer and engineering leader with 15+ years of experience building backend systems across travel, betting, fintech, AI, and market research. He works primarily with Java, C#, and Python and has held team-lead and Head of Engineering roles. He enjoys connecting technical decisions to user and business needs, building reliable systems, and helping engineering teams grow. A long-time Stack Overflow contributor and technical reviewer for Manning Publications, he also reviews proposals for developer conferences.

name: Patroklos Papapetrou
title: Software Engineer of all things
bio: Patroklos (Pat) has been a software engineer for more than 25 years - he's passionate about code quality and system perfection and keeping things simple. He's a book author and occasional speaker, and currently, he works as Senior Backend Engineer in Golang @ Banked.com. He was the founder of the Java Meetup in Thessaloniki, and the main organizer of Voxxed Thessaloniki and Devoxx Greece since 2016.

name: Thomas Pliakas
title: Senior Software Architect
bio: Thomas Pliakas is a senior passionate Java software engineer, where he likes to work in performance improvements in each phase of the project life cycle. He has primarily been working on architecture, development, and tuning low latency and high throughput telco products. He is also a co-organizer of Java Hellenic User Groups (jhug) meetups.

name: Sotiris Sotiropoulos
title: Senior User Researcher at Meta
bio:
Sotiris Sotiropoulos is a seasoned User Researcher, specializing in mixed methodologies. Committed to generating actionable insights from rigorous research, he plays a key role in informing product and business decisions.
With a background in human-computer interaction (HCI), he has contributed to shape the user experience landscape across various industries, including telco, banking, insurance, retail, mobility, and dev tools. Currently, he is working on improving Monitoring & Observability systems at Meta's Data Infra department.
Beyond his role, he is a passionate learner and he actively shares knowledge, coaches teams, mentors professionals, and supports the community.

name: Kostas Stroggylos
title: Principal Software Engineer II at Kaizen Gaming
bio: Kostas is a principal software engineer, currently fighting legacy and architecting novel software solutions at Kaizen Gaming. When not getting his hands dirty with code, he studies the sociotechnical aspects of complex systems. He is passionate about organizational agility and co-organizes Domain Driven Design Greece.

name: Gerasimos Xydas
title: Principal Entropy and Alchemy Professional
bio: Gerasimos Xydas has spent over 25 years working in Natural Language Processing, large-scale data systems, and software architecture. He holds a PhD in Text-to-Speech from the University of Athens and has authored more than 30 scientific publications. His experience spans research, engineering, and product development, including leading teams building enterprise software.
